title: The Peak Beyond Coordinate

features.name: the arch that points nowhere
features.desc-on-touch: you stand here and understand that coordinates are things that locations do to themselves; this place has refused the system

features.name: the absence of location
features.desc-on-touch: the GPS returns only silence; the map folds and forgets this place; it exists and does not exist at once

features.name: the certainty that has no place
features.desc-on-touch: absolute knowledge floating in absolute nowhere; the archive keeps it here because it cannot write it down

inscription: at a certain altitude, the grid becomes optional; the archive climbed so high it could refuse to be found

file.name: Coordinate_Null_Final_Report.txt
file.note: at this elevation the concept of location ceases to hold; GPS returns silence; the archive considers this a successful reading

exits.label: back down to where place still matters
further abstraction, where even absence has no address
toward the paradox where up and down trade places
